TOP: GHEIST: stolen GitHub tokens plant secret-stealing workflows
Critical Brotli flaw forces emergency .NET patches
Tailscale SSH runs as root: privilege escalation flaws
Anthropic IPO filing opens its books

P.h: GHEIST: stolen GitHub tokens used to plant secret-stealing workflows
P.p: Wiz tracked attackers using stolen tokens from more than 850 GitHub accounts to plant over 13,500 sync-check workflows. They base32-encode repository and environment secrets to dodge log masking, pull the logs through GitHub's own API, then delete the runs.
P.s: GitHub's approval hold blocked every public-repository run, but private repositories and GitHub Enterprise Server ran the payload. A newer variant sweeps self-hosted runners for cloud, Kubernetes and AI provider keys. Hunt for ci-sync-* branches and the gheist user agent, then rotate every reachable secret.

items.h: Emergency .NET fixes for Broccoli2Shell Brotli overflow
items.d: Microsoft shipped out-of-band fixes for .NET 8 through 11. The buffer overflow also hit Node.js, Python, Bun, Envoy, Istio and FFmpeg via crafted JPEG XL images. Rated Exploitation More Likely.

items.h: Tailscale SSH forwarding runs as root, enabling escalation
items.d: Researchers report verified flaws in Tailscale v1.104.2 and headscale v0.29.5, including root-file deletion, enrollment-key theft and unauthenticated memory exhaustion. Use per-pair SSH grants and egress allowlists.

items.h: Everest group claims 590GB PwC data theft
items.d: Claimed data includes HR and training exports, names, employment history and contact details. PwC acknowledged the breach but says the affected site held no client, personal or financial data.

items.h: Ex-pentester used Artex AI to steal 8.2M records
items.d: South Korean police arrested seven suspects who breached over 90 organizations and demanded $270,000 in 38 ransom cases. Korea's first arrest for large-scale AI-enabled hacking.

tiles.t: eMudhra: one CA private key was the number 4
tiles.d: Flawed April 2025 key ceremony zeroed the top 376 bits. Browsers blocked fast; Python, Go, Node, Java and curl skipped revocation until trust stores changed.

tiles.t: UK Biobank returns after 500K-record sale listing
tiles.d: Phased reopening: manual file review, no result downloads at first, 15-minute idle logouts with 2FA, SSH removed.
Hides in sideloaded Telegram builds and clones WeChat accounts. Leaked backend shows a rentable service.

tiles.t: Dutch police arrest two over NFC relay attacks
tiles.d: Bank help desk scheme stole more than 380,000 euros from 170 victims.

tiles.t: How LLM pentest harnesses really work
tiles.d: Cairn, Artex and Strix tested on a vulnerable shop. A simple Pi harness with DeepSeek found the account takeover.

P.h: Anthropic publishes its IPO filing as investors weigh AI costs
P.p: TLDR IT reports a first-half net loss of $80.7 billion, largely a non-operating convertible-bond item, while the operating loss narrowed to $693 million. The prospectus stresses growing compute costs and dependence on a few cloud and chip suppliers.
P.s: TLDR says the 400-page filing targets NASDAQ under ticker ANT, possibly the week before Thanksgiving, at a valuation of $1.5 trillion to $2 trillion. It also warns AI could aid bioweapons and destabilize geopolitics.

items.h: Claude Code team lets AI review most PRs
items.d: Claude is primary reviewer; a classifier decides zero, one or two humans per PR. Merged PRs more than doubled while reverts fell over 40% between June and September, per TLDR.

items.h: Devin Security runs deep scans on frontier cyber models
items.d: Re-scores findings against a living threat model and opens validated fix PRs. Risk relabeling needs human approval; KEV-listed flaws are never downgraded.

items.h: Consumer agents hold broad OAuth to enterprise SaaS
items.d: Executives grant unvetted agents expansive OAuth privileges, creating unmonitored non-human identities. Legacy tools are blind to it.

items.h: monday.com gave agents production keys, with guardrails
items.d: Agents resolved about 50 percent of roughly 1,688 monthly infrastructure tickets without human escalation.

tiles.d: Most features end September 30, 2028, leaving Teams integrations only. Migration pain ahead.

tiles.t: Cisco ships quantum-resilient Wi-Fi 7 access point
tiles.d: CW9176ISEC aligns with CNSA 2.0 and adds Auto MACsec.

tiles.t: Transit Gateway and Cloud WAN gain 1:1 NAT
tiles.d: Connect private networks sharing IP ranges without renumbering or NAT appliances.
Uptime and patch percentages can hide repeat incidents and open critical vulnerabilities.

tiles.t: New Outlook gets an All Accounts view
tiles.d: One inbox across accounts; rollout due late October.

items.h: OpenAI announces discoveries in math, CS and physics
items.d: Harmonic analysis, complexity theory and quantum field theory results, with outside groups to explain them.
Offers go to staff in Canada, India, the UK and the US. Microsoft expects fewer than 30% to accept.

items.h: Nvidia weighs $2,000-per-GPU yearly agent software fee
items.d: It already charges $4,500 per GPU for AI Enterprise; unclear if the two overlap.

items.h: DoorDash in advanced talks to buy Instacart
items.d: Deal would value Instacart near $17 billion and could close this week, with no guarantee.
